Q: SELECT rows ORDERed BY a column using CodeIgniter's query builder A:
  • Call order_by() with the column name of the column to sort by as the parameter.
  • get_where() will ignore the second parameter if it is null, so conditionally populate a $where array if the $brandId is not null.
  • Chain your methods together for maximum elegance and brevity.
  • All query building methods must be chained before the query executing method is chained.
  • Chain the result object processing method directly after the executing method.
  • Use array_column() to succinctly populate your desired associative array with ids as keys and model names as values.
public function getModelsForBrand(?int $brandId = null): array
{
    return array_column(
        $this->db
            ->select('id,model')
            ->order_by('model')
            ->get_where(
                'models',
                $brandId ? ['brand_id' => $brandId] : null
            )
            ->result(),
        'model',
        'id'
    );
}

Q: Counting instances of genotype strings where order is irrelevant within locus A:

For each string, sort its characters, put them back together and count the frequencies with table.

fun <- function(x) {
  lapply(x, strsplit, "") |> 
    unlist(recursive = FALSE, use.names = FALSE) |>
    lapply(sort) |>
    sapply(paste, collapse = "") |>
    table(useNA = "ifany")
}

fun(offspring)
#> 
#> aabb aabB aaBB aAbb aAbB aABB AAbb AAbB AABB 
#>    1    2    1    2    4    2    1    2    1

You can output as a data.frame by piping the above to as.data.frame.

fun(offspring) |> as.data.frame()

#> 1 aabb    1
#> 2 aabB    2
#> 3 aaBB    1
#> 4 aAbb    2
#> 5 aAbB    4
#> 6 aABB    2
#> 7 AAbb    1
#> 8 AAbB    2
#> 9 AABB    1

Q: Homepage Not Indexing in Google While Other Pages Are Indexed A:

What unique content is on your home page? Have you tried searching for a snippet from that unique content in quotes?

My guess is that your home page either doesn't have unique content and is getting excluded as duplicate, or you aren't actually searching for something that would pull up your home page.
